notes.title: Update Jan 1st 2025
notes.content:
First and foremost  Happy New Year! Happy 2025! 

[list]
[*] Reverted back to older more stable build. This will make the game harder, but should allow players to play with minimal stability issues, and make it to level ten without issue.  
[*] Increased the amount of points gained for combining three or more blocks  to compensate for the higher difficulty of the game after update. 
[/list]
